race.comment: BLOOMIN' RICH (10) has made an encouraging start to his career with a pair of fourth place finishes, and he will be suited stretching out to a mile for the first time here. He is still a maiden so will carry 3kg less this time, but he still has the scope to win a race like this. HUSSY LA VISTA (5) has been racing well since her easy maiden win at the Sapphire Coast in late July. He last start fourth at Hawkesbury at provincial level is good form for this race, and she can take this out. AVALON LADY (4) stepped up to this trip for the first time at Canberra 8 days ago and posted an overdue maiden win by a length. She can make full use of the pole position, and is expected to go right on with the job now. PASSING THROUGH (6) has needed time to mature, and she resumed in top shape when leading all the way to break her maiden status at Gundagai 4 weeks ago. She may take plenty of pegging back again in this.
